american_english: In this article, an attempt has been made to briefly shed light on the diverse tools and techniques used in creating sculptures in stone. Before the development of human civilization, stone itself was the primary foundation in the Stone Age. Afterwards, along with the beginning of civilization, the use of stone in birth and death was the primary basis in the Mesopotamian, Indus Valley, and Egyptian civilizations. Researchers also state that the use of stone has existed in Nepal since ancient times. The main reason stone is the best medium for making sculptures is considered to be that it has been used because it is permanent, attractive, and also available in various colors. To make this research article effective, an effort will be made to clarify the topic using various books, essays, and materials available on the internet. Although various books and articles have been published on the subject of sculpture, publications regarding the stone carving process and the tools used in it have not been found. For this reason, I hope that this article will prove useful.
